name: Commercial International Bank Egypt (CIB) S.A.E.
source: Yahoo Finance | H1 2026 column added 2026-11-22 from the condensed consolidated interim statement of financial position as at 30 June 2026 in Commercial International Bank (Egypt) S.A.E. RNS 1119N, 21 July 2026, EGP thousands scaled to EGP: total assets 1,690,039,928 and total equity including non-controlling interest 238,416,239 are printed on the face, so total liabilities 1,451,623,689 is derived as assets less equity and the identity closes exactly. Cash and balances with central banks is left empty for this column because the condensed statement as released does not print it in the text of the release; the FY2025 column carries 224,113,001 thousand from the prior audited statement. Non-current and current splits are empty because a bank statement of financial position does not present one and none of the other columns carries one.

rows.label: Total Liabilities
rows.derivedFormula: Total Liabilities = Total Assets - Total Equity
